svg.aria-label: oupdate by AKA Security, recurring, gated dependency updates for a fleet of hosts. Illustration: update trucks for npm, pnpm, bun and brew wait in a striped cooldown lot; under an overhead board reading advisories one flagged truck's lane is closed, and a gate releases the rest onto the fleet road.
svg.title: oupdate
